mapper.sql: SELECT task_id::text, tenant_id::text, kind, target_id, invocation_id, payload, state, attempts, last_error, created_at, updated_at, next_retry_at FROM cap_compensation_task
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO cap_compensation_task (task_id, tenant_id, kind, target_id, invocation_id, payload, state, attempts, last_error, created_at, updated_at, next_retry_at) VALUES (#{taskId}::uuid, #{tenantId}::uuid, #{kind}, #{targetId}, #{invocationId}, #{payload}, #{state}, #{attempts}, #{lastError}, #{createdAt}, #{updatedAt}, #{nextRetryAt}) ON CONFLICT (tenant_id, kind, target_id) DO NOTHING
mapper.select: WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId}::uuid AND state IN ('PENDING', 'FAILED') AND (next_retry_at IS NULL OR next_retry_at <= now()) ORDER BY created_at ASC LIMIT #{limit}
mapper.update: UPDATE cap_compensation_task SET state = 'COMPLETED', updated_at = now() WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId}::uuid AND task_id = #{taskId}::uuid AND state IN ('PENDING', 'RUNNING', 'FAILED')

UPDATE cap_compensation_task SET state = 'FAILED', attempts = attempts + 1, last_error = #{error}, next_retry_at = #{nextRetryAt}, updated_at = now() WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId}::uuid AND task_id = #{taskId}::uuid AND state IN ('PENDING', 'RUNNING')
